summary: Sale deed vs practice of ta khubzul badlain in Bihar; title transfer postponed until exchange of equivalents; unilateral cancellation invalid; Specific Relief Act, s.31 remedy applicable; High Court reversal based on non-payment of consideration; Supreme Court examines consistency with precedent; emphasis on intention of parties and regional custom.
legal_provisions_cited: Transfer of Property Act, 1882 s.54, s.55(4)(b)
Janak Dulari & Anr. v. Kapildeo Rai & Anr. (2011) 6 SCC 555
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment of High Court set aside; decree of Trial Court restored.
